podcast.body: The introduction of this 1973 song features a famous cash register sequence, which serves as a prime example of old-school sound manipulation. This effect was created using reels of magnetic tape, where the desired sound bites were carefully measured, cut with a razor blade, and then pieced together using splicing tape to form a loop. The process was described as mind-numbing and took hours to complete. "This whole cash register sequence was measured out, cut up, and then carefully looped."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
